name: family-and-production
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; TRACK_M_DISPOSABLE_PROFILE=1 bun research/track-m/install-cost-meter.ts /tmp/integrated-originals >/tmp/integrated-manifest; TRACK_M_COST_PROFILE=1 TRACK_M_FAMILY_TRACE=1 timeout -s KILL 180 bun research/track-m/profile-family.ts replay-input/input.json; TRACK_M_COST_PROFILE=1 timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/track-m/profile-production.ts production
